C1326.title: Empirical Study of Shadow AI in Australian Critical Infrastructure Sectors
C1326.summary: Researchers interviewed 27 Australian critical infrastructure organizations across communications, energy, and water sectors and found that shadow AI bypasses existing safeguards and oversight mechanisms.
